outputs: Generated answers for question answering tasks
The models generate responses to questions, and these generated outputs are analyzed for hallucinations.

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate task entries and consolidated output descriptions. Kept only the most concise output description.
All metrics are correctly extracted and normalized. AUROC (Area Under ROC Curve), PPL (Perplexity), and LN-Entropy (Length-Normalized Entropy) are all used for evaluation.

Removed all metadata since the paper does NOT use LLMs as judges. The 'auxiliary LLM' mentioned is part of the LLM-check baseline method description, not an evaluator method used by the authors. This paper uses automatic metrics (AUROC, PPL, etc.) and their proposed ICR Probe for evaluation, not LLM-as-judge approaches.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The evaluation is entirely automated using metrics and probes.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on hallucination detection in LLM-generated question answering outputs. It evaluates using automatic metrics (AUROC, PPL, LN-Entropy) and proposes the ICR Probe method. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge approaches are used. The extraction was generally accurate but included some baseline method details that shouldn't be attributed to the authors' own evaluation approach.
